title: Petunia AN2 promoter construct verification
biological_context: AN2 is an R2R3-MYB regulator associated with the petunia anthocyanin pigmentation program.
hypothesis: Clone the 2 kb upstream / 500 bp downstream AN2 TSS region for subsequent regulatory testing.
boundary: The pUC19 construct is a molecular verification demonstration, not a plant expression vector or evidence that changing AN2 regulation alters flower color.
